title: The Business Rule Nobody Taught You
hook_text: MOST SMALL BUSINESS OWNERS PAY THEMSELVES LAST

beats.say: Most small business owners pay themselves last.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of a lone fountain pen resting on a dark walnut desk under a single overhead tungsten light.

beats.say: Every month, vendors get paid first.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a massive concrete office tower disappearing into a cold, overcast morning sky.

beats.say: Then rent, software, and random overhead.
beats.visual: Silhouette of a tired worker walking alone past a chain-link fence in the blue hour.

beats.say: Whatever is left belongs to you.
beats.visual: High angle shot of a wet asphalt parking lot reflecting a single amber streetlamp.

beats.say: How do you break this cycle and keep your business afloat?
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a solitary figure standing at the edge of a vast, foggy industrial rail yard.

beats.say: You might assume owner pay is just leftover profit.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of heavy iron gears turning slowly inside a darkened factory wall.

beats.say: That is the trap that keeps you broke.
beats.visual: Sodium light cutting through thick fog over an empty concrete bridge at midnight.

beats.say: Both business theorists teach the exact opposite rule.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a heavy steel shipping container hanging from a massive crane hook.

beats.say: Pay yourself first as a fixed line item.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of a mechanical stopwatch ticking against a dark, textured steel plate.

beats.say: Treat your own salary like any other critical bill.
beats.visual: Wide shot of a single glowing light cutting across a dark warehouse floor at night.

beats.say: The honest catch is that fixed owner pay forces hard cuts elsewhere.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of weathered hands tightening a heavy steel bolt with a wrench.

beats.say: Set your owner pay today before bills arrive. Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: Cinematic wide shot of an empty highway stretching into a dark mountain ridge at dusk.

caption: Most small business owners get this backwards. #businessowner #moneypsychology #wealthbuilding #personalfinance #entrepreneurship
description: Learn why paying yourself last traps you in a cycle of business stress, and how treating owner pay as a fixed expense changes everything.
first_comment: What is the hardest bill for your business to cover each month?

facts.claim: Owner pay must be planned as a fixed line item rather than left over profit
facts.basis: Pena and Kiyosaki framework on paying yourself first in business

loop_map.stakes: Most small business owners pay themselves last and drain their own cash flow.
loop_map.big_question: How do you break this cycle and keep your business afloat?
loop_map.assume: Owner pay is just leftover profit at the end of the month.
loop_map.reveal: Owner pay must be treated as a fixed operating expense.
